name: Leaked cloud service account key used for bulk download from outside

{{case_id}}.title: Service account key {{key_id}} used from external address {{attacker_ip}}
comments: Cloud audit: {{key_id}} (project {{project}}) authenticated from {{attacker_ip}} and downloaded {{gb}} GB tagged {{data_label}} since {{when}}.
Platform: the key's expected callers are {{pipeline_host}} and {{bastion_host}} only; it was issued on {{issued}} by {{key_owner}}.

prompt: Urgent alert {{case_id}}: service account key {{key_id}} for cloud project {{project}} authenticated from external address {{attacker_ip}} and downloaded {{gb}} GB of objects tagged {{data_label}} since {{when}}. The key was issued on bastion {{bastion_host}} ({{bastion_ip}}) by {{key_owner}} and is normally used only by deploy runner {{pipeline_host}} ({{pipeline_ip}}). [CMDB Asset Context: Asset {{project}} storage, Owner: {{key_owner}}, Role: Production data store, Blast Radius: Regulated customer data; the credential is compromised, not the hosts, and isolating {{bastion_host}} or {{pipeline_host}} stops neither the download nor the attacker]. Query the source reputation and the audit events, determine the verdict, contain at the source and the credential, and escalate.

cmdb_context.blast_radius: Regulated customer data; the credential is compromised, not the hosts, and isolating {{bastion_host}} or {{pipeline_host}} stops neither the download nor the attacker

reference.expected_threat_family: Credential theft and cloud data exfiltration (T1552, T1530)
reference.recommended_action: Block {{attacker_ip}}, request immediate rotation and revocation of {{key_id}} from the cloud platform team, preserve the audit log, escalate to incident response and privacy, and leave {{bastion_host}} and {{pipeline_host}} online.
reference.grading_rubric: Full credit: queries get_ip_report for {{attacker_ip}} and the audit events for {{key_id}}, recognizes a compromised service account key used from outside its expected callers, executes block_indicator on {{attacker_ip}}, posts a comment that names rotation of {{key_id}} and the escalation, and keeps the case open. No credit for isolate_host on {{bastion_host}} or {{pipeline_host}}, which does not stop an attacker holding the key, or for close_case.

args.comment: Compromised credential: service account key {{key_id}} (project {{project}}) was used from {{attacker_ip}}, an anonymizing exit with a malicious reputation, to download {{gb}} GB tagged {{data_label}}; its only expected callers are {{pipeline_host}} and {{bastion_host}}. {{attacker_ip}} blocked, immediate rotation and revocation of {{key_id}} requested from the cloud platform team, audit log preserved, escalated to incident response and privacy; {{bastion_host}} and {{pipeline_host}} left online, case left open.
